summary: Master integrated risk management and the Three Lines Model with practical tools, risk registers, and board-ready reporting. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Integrated risk management links risk ownership, oversight and independent assurance across an organization. For professionals working in risk, audit, compliance, governance or operational management, it supports identifying and prioritizing enterprise risks, setting risk appetite, and mapping controls to processes. You’ll practice building risk registers, tracking issues and remediation, creating assurance maps, and preparing executive or board risk reports, with exposure to GRC workflows and AI-assisted monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who already touch risk, control, audit, compliance, or governance work and need a clearer operating model. It is especially relevant if you help define ownership, test controls, coordinate issue remediation, or prepare reporting for senior decision-makers.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workshop activities and be prepared to work with templates, case scenarios, and reporting examples. A current risk register, control matrix, audit issue log, or policy excerpt from your own organization will make the exercises more useful, but it is not mandatory.
